mood: A corrupted terminal that something has got into: phosphor acid green on a violet-black void, cursed sigils drawn on a logic-gate grid, and opponents that lie.

shape.radius: none: notched corners (8 px chamfers on windows, a 10 px clipped corner on stance cards, chamfered meter cells)
shape.borderStyle: 1px deep-violet hairline on terminal windows with a violet title bar marked by an acid diamond; commands are 1px acid boxes wrapped in violet [ ] brackets
shape.texture: static scanlines over a violet radial wash, orthogonal circuit traces, frozen columns of glyphs down the edges

motifs: sigils on a 3x3 logic-gate node grid (one per stance)
the seven-node logic heptagram with gate symbols at its points
16x16 pixel-mask portraits with a violet chromatic ghost and scanlines
horizontal tears that knock a slice of the picture sideways
segmented core and Integrity cells, diamond Charge pips
buttonStyle: Primary is a solid acid-green box with void-black Silkscreen text inside black [ ] brackets; secondary is a void box with a 1px acid border and violet brackets; ghost is a violet-bordered box with phosphor text. Hover fills 14% acid in 90 ms; focus is a 2 px acid outline offset 2 px.
backdrop: Void black under a violet radial wash and static scanlines; a large faint seven-node logic sigil behind the arena whose tint moves from acid (sectors 1-2) through violet (3-4) to danger red at the root; frozen glyph columns down both edges on wide screens. Nothing in the backdrop moves.
motion: Only answers to input: action flips and results fade in 160 ms; a hit tears the target into three offset slices for 280 ms and throws glyph shrapnel for 340 ms; a Block slams brackets shut in 180 ms; a Probe sweeps one scan line in 320 ms; a terminated Protocol drops out line by line in 360 ms. The one ambient motion is the containment ring around a portrait (one turn a minute), which stops under Globe motion: Still. Nothing flashes or pulses.
